北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾，体感 7℃ 较凉，外出记得防护保暖哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has haze and feels cool at 7℃. Remember to protect yourself and stay warm when out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，体感 8℃ 稍凉，记得添衣别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny, but feels a bit cool at 8℃. Remember to layer up and avoid catching a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗，体感 8℃ 凉意十足，外出别忘添衣。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is clear and feels chilly at 8℃. Don't forget to layer up when you go out!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光明媚，体感 21℃ 舒适宜人，尽情享受好天气吧。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is bright and sunny, feeling comfortable at 21℃. Enjoy the beautiful weather!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴好，体感 20℃ 暖洋洋，出行带件薄外套就够啦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is clear and feels warm at 20℃. A light jacket is enough when heading out!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 7℃ 偏凉，风力 3级 注意保暖防风哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny but feels chilly at 7℃ with a 3-level wind. Stay warm and protect from wind!
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 8℃ 凉意明显，外出注意添衣保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, but feels distinctly cool at 8℃. Remember to layer up and stay warm when out.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 15℃ 略凉，出门记得带把伞以防万一哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feeling slightly cool at 15℃. Remember to bring an umbrella just in case!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 17℃ 舒适。早晚温差大，记得添减衣物哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feeling comfortable at 17℃. Mind the temperature difference between morning and night, and adjust your clothing.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 13℃ 偏凉，湿度 12% 干燥，注意补水哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feeling cool at 13℃, and dry at 12% humidity. Remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 22℃ 暖和舒适，早晚添衣别着凉。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feeling warm and comfortable at 22℃. Add layers in morning/evening to avoid colds.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -3℃ 非常寒冷，务必穿厚实保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but feels very cold at -3℃. Make sure to dress warmly!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 1℃ 寒意浓，务必注意防寒保暖哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feeling quite cold at 1℃. Be sure to stay warm and protect from the cold!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 11℃ 稍凉，出行带件薄外套备用。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feeling a bit cool at 11℃. Bring a light jacket when you go out.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 9℃ 稍冷，风力 3级 记得防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, but feels a bit cold at 9℃ with a 3-level wind. Remember to stay warm and protect from wind.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 4℃ 寒冷，出门记得多穿点保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, but feels cold at 4℃. Remember to bundle up and stay warm when you go out.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 -1℃ 寒冷，注意防风保暖哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, but feels cold at -1℃. Remember to protect from wind and stay warm.
